authority: Original PR #1 alpha-first continuation. Terminal wealth and cross-scope alpha remain the discovery priority; MDD, orders and turnover are recorded but are not discovery gates.
root_cause: The settled-reference-rearm candidate can hold one dominant actual position while the second nominal slot exists only on paper. In joint optical-leader removal on 2025-11-20, about 99.3% of target capital remains in sz002371 while the second-slot attempt is about 0.7%. Candidate1's displacement branch is gated by vacancy == 0, so the nominal vacancy suppresses replacement even though observed cash is below the engine's existing 1%-NAV ordinary-order materiality and cannot deploy a normal new position. The weak incumbent can therefore monopolize capital while repeated tiny vacancy fills are blocked or immaterial.
economic_hypothesis: A slot is economically vacant only when observed capital can fund an executable ordinary admission. When nominal position count says vacancy but actual cash is below the unchanged execution engine's 1%-NAV ordinary-order floor, the portfolio is effectively capital-full. In that state, a decayed incumbent should remain eligible for the same campaign-reference displacement used by candidate1, so a materially stronger causal challenger can cause a sale and release real capital. This should preserve settled-reference rearm's shock/campaign improvements while removing capital starvation caused by nominal empty slots.

treatment.base: Reuse offensive_settled_reference_rearm unchanged for acute invalidation, settlement-aware reference rearm, trend-edge fallback, actual-inventory reconciliation and every ordinary candidate1 ownership rule.
treatment.deployable_vacancy: Use the execution engine's already-existing ordinary-order materiality, 0.01 * observed NAV. A nominal vacancy is considered deployable only when observed cash is at least that amount. No new percentage or tuned threshold is introduced.
treatment.capital_full_displacement: After settled-reference state transitions and mandatory exit retries are resolved, if actual held count is below Config.max_positions but observed cash is below 0.01 * observed NAV, evaluate the exact candidate1 displacement predicate instead of treating the nominal vacancy as protection for incumbents: current market trend must be open; an actually held incumbent must have finite owned admission reference and current causal score below that reference; an ordinary currently eligible unheld challenger must have current causal score above that same incumbent reference. Sell only the weakest decayed incumbent using the same deterministic tie-break. Do not buy the challenger on the sale close.
treatment.funding: No forecast sale proceeds are spent. The sale executes under unchanged next-session price-limit, liquidity, T+1, lot, fee and slippage constraints. Only a later close with actual observed cash can fill a vacancy under the unchanged base owner.
treatment.ordinary_vacancy: If observed cash is at least 0.01 * observed NAV, retain settled-reference-rearm exactly: use the existing vacancy path and do not force a displacement merely because a stronger challenger exists.
treatment.execution: Unchanged cash-only long-only close decision / next-session execution, no leverage or shorting, sells before buys, prior-volume capacity, board lots, 1%-NAV ordinary order materiality, fees, slippage and price limits.

structural_difference_from_prior_failure: Not joint_funding/allocation_auction: no risk/cash allocation weights, simultaneous funding geometry or resource sharing is changed.

Not opportunity_reassignment: that candidate acts only on a full two-slot book at scheduled reviews with a 1.25 leadership margin. This candidate addresses the opposite state: fewer actual names than max_positions but a vacancy that is provably undeployable under the existing execution minimum. There is no scheduled review or new score multiplier.
Not generic handover/reentry: no wait days, price recovery, confirmation count or reentry threshold is added; settled-reference rearm remains unchanged.
Not a risk patch: no account exposure cap, market shock gate, cooldown or defensive state is added. The mechanism only removes an opportunity-cost deadlock.

measurement.primary_objective: maximize mean(log(terminal wealth)) across the three fixed scopes
measurement.secondary_objective: maximize minimum terminal wealth across the three fixed scopes
measurement.promotion_rule: Advance only if mean-log wealth and minimum wealth improve versus exact trend_book control, at least one broad scope improves, and joint optical-leader removal remains above 1.0. If it advances, evaluate the same source-bound candidate over the full frozen 896 sessions and fixed 2026 windows before deciding whether it becomes the alpha leader.
measurement.failure_rule: If rejected, preserve the exact failure and do not search materiality percentages, score margins, review cadences, position counts, shock thresholds or wait lengths.

prohibitions: No neighboring parameter search or winner splicing
